title: Improved Road Connectivity by Joint Learning of Orientation and Segmentation
mechanism: Add an auxiliary task predicting binned road orientation along the label skeleton, sharing features with segmentation, plus a refinement step that closes small gaps.
adaptation: Orientation bins (16) computed from the crack label skeleton via PCA in a 7 px window; a 1 px jitter barely changes orientation, so the target is jitter-robust. Also apply to gridline/busbar/ribbon (layout-fixed directions) to help gridline recall 0.33.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + 16-bin orientation CE on crack and gridline skeleton pixels; baseline = PF; 5 seeds + 5-fold CV; metrics crack components >=20 px found, relF1@2, gridline IoU. Kill if components gain < 0.02 and gridline IoU gain < 0.02.
evidence: R: SpaceNet and DeepGlobe roads, better connectivity (APLS) with the orientation task; exact numbers not read.
prior_overlap: None; no orientation or direction target has been trained here.

alt_notes.adaptation: 16 orientation bins from crack skeleton second moments in a 7x7 window (95.8% of px stay within +-1 bin under 1 px label shift, team E); also apply to gridline and busbar whose orientation is fixed by cell layout (gridline IoU 0.283). Refinement net optional, trained on our own corrupted crack masks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Within T5 arm 4 (stacked); if it passes, decomposition arm PF + orientation only vs PF; metric components >=20 px found, gridline IoU; kill if components +<0.02 and gridline IoU +<0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: (a) Orientation head: 16 angle bins from the crack skeleton tangent, dilated 2 px, CE on crack pixels only. Orientation stays stable under 1-2 px label jitter. (b) Train a mask-to-mask refiner on the 478 train crack masks with random breaks, gaps and shifts. This needs no new labels and adds the refinement stage that has never been tried here.
alt_notes.min_experiment: (a) Orientation aux vs house, 5 seeds. (b) Refiner on the house ensemble output vs the ensemble alone. Metrics: crack relR@2 at fixed relP@2, components found, E1 recall. Kill if relR@2 gains < 0.01.
